title: ∞ Asset Migration from 3.3 to 4.0 configuration file

http_username.description: the directory http username, usually 'infinite', if undefined 'infinite' is used

infinite_admin_username.description: the directory infinite username, usually 'infinite', if undefined 'http_username' is used

infinite_admin_password.description: the directory infinite password, if undefined 'http_password' is used

asset_file.description: the ndjson file of the assets to restore

verifyssl.description: if set to false, ssl verification is disabled

owner_users.description: list of user ids ('U' prefixed) that replace the read/write access list of every migrated asset. If undefined, the original access list is kept

max_chunk_size.description: Data will be sent by chunk of this size (in MB), if undefined, defaults to 256
